Speaking Tokens

BoobaStudio's Speaking Tokens feature lets you give voices to your tokens using AI-powered text-to-speech. When configured, tokens can speak with unique voices during gameplay, adding immersion to your sessions.

Overview

Speaking Tokens uses ElevenLabs text-to-speech technology to generate speech audio for your tokens. Each token can have its own voice configured, allowing NPCs, monsters, and characters to sound distinct.

How It Works

  • Configure Voice: Select a token on the canvas and open its Token HUD
  • Record Samples: Use the BoobaStudio icon on the Token HUD to assign a voice or record voice samples
  • Trigger Speech: During gameplay, use the Token HUD to make the token speak with the configured voice
  • Playback: The generated audio plays for all connected players

Setting Up a Speaking Token

Step 1: Place a Token

Make sure you have a scene with at least one token placed on the canvas. The token should be linked to an actor.

Step 2: Open the Token HUD

  • Select the token on the canvas by clicking it
  • Right-click the token (or double-click, depending on your settings) to open the Token HUD
  • Look for the BoobaStudio icon on the right side of the HUD

Step 3: Configure Voice

  • Click the BoobaStudio icon on the Token HUD
  • If no voice samples are configured yet, the TTS Voice Configuration panel opens
  • Choose a voice from the available ElevenLabs voices or record/upload voice samples
  • Save the configuration

Step 4: Use Speaking Tokens

Once configured:

  • Select the token on the canvas
  • Open the Token HUD
  • Click the BoobaStudio icon
  • The Speaking Tokens panel shows your configured voice samples
  • Type text and click to generate speech, or use predefined phrases

Voice Configuration

Voice Samples

Voice samples are stored as flags on the token document. They can be configured per-token or inherited from the linked actor:

  • Token-specific voices: Set directly on the token, useful for unique NPCs
  • Actor-linked voices: Set on the actor, shared across all linked tokens of that actor

ElevenLabs Voices

The TTS system uses ElevenLabs for high-quality voice generation. You can:

  • Browse available voices by category (e.g., male, female, fantasy, etc.)
  • Preview voices before assigning them
  • Adjust voice settings like stability and similarity

Tips

  • Link tokens to actors so voice configuration persists across scenes
  • Use different voices for different NPC types to help players distinguish characters
  • Keep phrases short for faster generation and more natural-sounding speech
  • Voice generation requires an active A configured provider

Requirements

  • BoobaStudio module installed and configured
  • A configured narration (TTS) provider
  • A scene with tokens placed on the canvas
  • GM permissions (Speaking Tokens configuration is GM-only)
